text:
Noah: spinning up a thread for TestHarbor pilot planning — goal: quick, iterative beta to validate inference latency & cost controls in real product flows. wanted a short sync on recruitment, metrics, and gating.
Priya: propose rolling cohort of 8 orgs, 6 weeks each, staggered starts every 2 weeks. Mix hosted + 2 VPCs. Keep API surface minimal: chat + embeddings.
Jun: infra note: stagger helps capacity but increases bookkeeping. For hosted we can allocate a small Dedicated pool reserved per start window. Need INFRA-THAR-001 ticket.
Olga: success metrics idea: per-org rolling retention (weekly active power users >=40%), cost delta vs baseline <= -15%, error rate <0.8%, and 2 product hooks used. Also need qualitative SLAs: monthly 30m interviews + post-pilot debrief.
Riya: recruitment: split candidates 4 existing customers (who asked for perf work) + 4 new prospects. Offer $5k professional services credit or 3 months bill credit for deep engagement.
InfraBot: infra-bot: Please open INFRA-THAR-001 and tag windows: 2025-05-05 to 2025-08-01. Capacity hold requested for dedicated: 2x GPUs per cohort window.
Priya: instrumentation: require request tags (pilot:thar, org_id, flow) and sampling for session traces. quick example header: 
```http
POST /v1/generate
Headers: {"x-pilot":"thar-2025", "x-org":"org_123"}
```
Jun: add guard: automatic fallback to smaller-quantized variant when p95 > target for >5 minutes, and alert at 3xff errors. We should record fallback events for analysis.
Noah: launch gates before onboarding first org in a window: 1) tagging + traces validated end-to-end, 2) dedicated capacity confirmed, 3) onboarding doc + security ack from customer, 4) two internal smoke tests using real product prompts.
Olga: regression detection: collect 8 golden prompts per org and run daily eval; flag if quality drop >10% compared to baseline. Also keep a short survey (3 qs) after each major change.
Riya: outreach plan: templated invite, kickoff call, weekly async pulse, monthly interview. Incentive conditional on 80% completion of feedback requests.
Jun: operational note: for VPC installs, require shared runbook for peering + KMS proof; expect +7 business days. Mark VPC cohorts as "high-touch" in tracker.
Priya: scope negotiation: start strictly with chat + embeddings. If after week 2 stability under load looks good, enable streaming for a small subset. No tool-calling in initial rollouts.
Noah: exit criteria for a successful cohort: meets core metrics, at least 3 orgs indicate willingness to continue + commit to next-step contract or pilot report, and no unresolved security blocker.
Olga: failure modes and mitigations: if adoption low by week 3, schedule product workshop + engineer pairing; if perf regresses, toggle quantized fallback and run postmortem.
Riya: action items: - Noah: draft invite + pilot one-pager by Tue - Priya: define tagging schema & telemetry contract by Mon - Jun: open INFRA-THAR-001 and reserve capacity by EOD - Olga: prepare golden-prompt template and survey by Wed - Riya: shortlist nominees and send invites by Thu
Noah: cool, I'll open the shared timeline doc and add the gating checklist. ping me if you'd rather a single 8-org cohort vs rolling.
Jun: I'll run a small perf sweep today simulating 2k token chats and post numbers.
InfraBot: reminder: TestHarbor kickoff meeting scheduled next Thursday 9:30am PT.
